Container.Name: Connectome
Container.Overview: Connectome host by Anima Labs (unofficial community container; upstream has no license and is not affiliated). It runs a persistent, stateful AI agent from a JSON recipe, with long-term memory (Chronicle), MCP/MCPL tools and a web operator console on port 7340, protected by basic auth. It runs as PUID/PGID (default 99:100, unRAID's nobody:users). Pick your LLM provider with Provider: anthropic (Anthropic API key), openrouter (OpenRouter key and Model), openai-responses (OpenAI key), openai-compatible (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. Venice at https://api.venice.ai/api/v1 or a local Ollama; needs Base URL, Model and the OpenAI-compatible API key), or bedrock (AWS keys). On first start a recipe for that provider is written to /config/recipe.json. Edit it to customise the agent. Changing Provider later only takes effect after deleting that file or starting once with Regenerate Recipe=true.
Container.Requires: An API key for your chosen LLM provider (not needed for a local OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama).

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Web operator console and /healthz

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Sessions, Chronicle store, LLM call logs, IPC socket (DATA_DIR)

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Holds recipe.json (and mcpl-servers.json if used). A default recipe is created if missing.

Config.Name: Provider
Config.Description: LLM provider for the generated recipe. openai-compatible covers Venice, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and similar (needs Base URL and Model).

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Provider openai-compatible only: endpoint URL, e.g. Venice https://api.venice.ai/api/v1 or Ollama http://<host>:11434/v1

Config.Name: OpenAI-compatible API Key
Config.Description: Provider openai-compatible: API key for that endpoint (e.g. Venice). Leave empty for local servers without auth

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: Provider anthropic: Anthropic API key (sk-ant-...)

Config.Name: Anthropic Auth Token
Config.Description: Optional: Claude subscription token from 'claude setup-token', instead of an API key

Config.Name: Web UI Username
Config.Description: Basic-auth username for the web UI

Config.Name: Web UI Password
Config.Description: Basic-auth password for the web UI. Required: the host refuses to bind to 0.0.0.0 without it.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Model id. REQUIRED for openai-compatible and openrouter (e.g. a Venice model id, llama3.1:8b for Ollama, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4 for OpenRouter); optional for others

Config.Name: Agent Name
Config.Description: Agent name used by the default recipe

Config.Name: Agent Timezone
Config.Description: IANA zone for the agent's wall clock

Config.Name: Regenerate Recipe
Config.Description: true = back up /config/recipe.json and regenerate it from these settings on every start. Set it back to false afterwards

Config.Name: Recipe Path
Config.Description: Recipe file or URL to load

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Provider openai-responses: OpenAI API key

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: Provider openrouter: OpenRouter API key

Config.Name: AWS Access Key ID
Config.Description: Provider bedrock

Config.Name: AWS Secret Access Key
Config.Description: Provider bedrock

Config.Name: AWS Region
Config.Description: Provider bedrock

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (unRAID default: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (unRAID default: 100 = users)

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: umask for files the app creates
